MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with these Basic Environment Descriptors.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with these Basic Environment Descriptors.

BasicEnvironmentDescriptorsTime.description: The instant the descriptors describe: every Basic Environment Object is brought to it.

EgoSpatialAttitude.description: The Spatial Attitude of the CAV at that instant, from Spatial Attitude Generation: the frame of reference of every Basic Environment Object.

BasicEnvironmentObjects.description: What the CAV perceives around it, fused from every Environment Sensing Technology and from the Offline Map: moving and static objects, and the elements of the road.

BasicAudioVisualSceneDescriptors.description: Optional: the audio-visual part of the environment in the form MPAI-OSD specifies, for applications that consume it.

WeatherData.description: The Weather Data the descriptors were produced under.

BasicEnvironmentObjectID.description: Kept from one instance of the descriptors to the next for as long as the object is perceived: a track.

InstanceIdentifier.description: What the object is - vehicle, pedestrian, cyclist, siren, lane, traffic sign... - against a taxonomy, with the confidence of each candidate.

SpatialAttitude.description: Position and orientation, their velocities and accelerations, each with its accuracy, relative to the EgoSpatialAttitude.

Extent.description: The space the object occupies: a 3D Bounding Box.

ExistenceConfidence.description: The confidence that the object exists.

Motion.description: Static: part of the road or its surroundings, as the Offline Map knows them or the sensors establish; Dynamic: a road user or other moving object.

SceneDescriptorsID.description: The Basic Scene Descriptors instance the object was fused from; for Remote, the Full Environment Descriptors.

Contributions.description: What the object was fused from.
